name: openbb_equity_profile
description:
Company profile for one stock through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.profile).
Returns: {symbol, profile: one record (name, sector, industry, market cap, employees, description, website, address and other provider fields)}; an empty object when none.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (fmp, intrinio or yfinance; default yfinance, no key).
Other sources: yf_stock_info, av_company_overview; executives: openbb_equity_management. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT", "provider": "yfinance"}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)
